as_used_in_demo_config_mode.note: agentmint init config present: per call loads the keystore, signs Ed25519, writes receipt JSON + chain_state.json to disk; timestamper=none

ephemeral_notary_no_timestamp.note: in-memory Notary(), explicit plan=, enable_timestamp=False; no disk, no network

ephemeral_notary_default_timestamp.note: decorator default enable_timestamp=True calls freetsa.org per receipt (RFC 3161, digest only). Measured once by mistake; freetsa.org is outside this experiment's allow-list. Not used by the demo.

agentmint_integration_lines.optional_reporting_lines: rid() helper + RECEIPTS print (5 lines) only surface receipt IDs in logs; not needed for signing
